content: Insurance agent Ramesh Tiwari emailed a revised quote for the reinstatement of Rohan Ahuja's expired auto policy, noting that the lapse fee has been reduced after negotiating with the underwriter. Rohan acknowledged receipt, thanked Ramesh for his efforts, and stated he will review the quote and respond by the end of the day.

action_items: Rohan Ahuja to review the revised quote and respond by the end of the day
